conditions: This describes a successful call to read on a readable textual Lisp expression. An omitted or nil stream uses standard-input.
limitations: The claim leaves the read syntax of individual types and the behavior of loaders, byte-code, and native code outside scope.

triggers: Exact publisher representation changed, source correction, or contrary language or edition evidence.

statement: In GNU Emacs 29.4 Emacs Lisp, a successful read consumes one textual Lisp expression from its input stream and returns the corresponding Lisp object. Evaluation is a separate operation that the caller may choose to perform on that object.
